name: $DASHA
goal: Improve the public $DASHA product and open-source tooling through useful, reviewable GitHub contributions.

requirements: Work must address a real open issue, documented task, reproducible bug, or clearly useful improvement.
Changes must preserve the exact associated mint and existing security/custody boundaries.
The pull request must include focused verification evidence and must not fabricate live deployment, reward, identity, or payment state.
Acceptance occurs only when a maintainer merges or explicitly records acceptance in GitHub.
